messages:
mira-csm: Kicking off TerraForge Dedicated bring-up thread. Quota approved = 32 GPUs (8 nodes), autoscale = gradual spike (min 2 / max 32). Need final agreement on priming approach and renewal notes.

tony-ops: Reservation booked Mon 06:00 UTC. Recommend a controlled soak: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% over four days. Prefer we avoid full-burst on first day.

diego-eng: Agreed. Can someone confirm replica KV cache sizing? Our defaults might under-allocate for their prompt fanout.

nora-se: I'll run a sizing probe and post expected hit-rate numbers. Also setting up a canary route that falls back to cpu-small-model when GPU queue latency > 400ms.

mira-csm: Renewal flag: TerraForge mentioned pricing concerns in QBR. Angelo, can you prep a simple delta-cost model for q8_4 vs q4_0 quant profiles so we can show savings vs quality?

angelo-accounts: On it. I'll run a quick TCO with projected monthly tokens and share a chart. Do we have permission to run quant profiles on a read-only replica?

diego-eng: Yes — set up a read-only replica in the same pool. Nora, include their top-15 prompt set for eval.

nora-se: Will do. Also note: we should enable node-level debug logs only for the smoke window to avoid volume retention costs.

runbot: action scheduled: smoke-priming v2 -> staging at 2026-10-29T06:30:00Z (notify #eng-runtime on completion).

tony-ops: Loadtest window proposed Wed 13:00-15:00 UTC. Ops on-call: diego + tony from 12:30-16:00 UTC. Please confirm.

mira-csm: Confirmed for me. I'll also invite TerraForge to observe the tail end of the test.

angelo-accounts: Shared cost comparison doc: https://redwood.internal/price-deltas/terra-qmodels (placeholder). Will run numbers by Friday EOD.

diego-eng: Technical checklist: 1) KV size probe done; 2) KMS key rotation must be complete before canary; 3) tracing hooks enabled; 4) fallback model image uploaded. I'll post status updates.

nora-se: KV probe results: expect 73-87% hit rate on typical traffic if we use 32GB KV per node. Posting numbers to the onboarding doc.

mira-csm: Enablement plan: short SRE playbook, 30-min walkthrough, and a recorded runbook clip. Scheduling walkthrough Thu 17:00 PT. Angelo will join for the billing Q&A.

tony-ops: If quant eval shows >2% quality regression on top prompts, we keep quant disabled in canary and open a model-team ticket. Otherwise, enable q8_4 for cost saving pilot.

nora-se: I'll run the quant A/B with the top-15 prompts and push a short summary. Expect results by Monday.

mira-csm: Action items recap: mira -> customer comms + invite; diego -> infra checklist + canary; nora -> KV probe + quant eval; angelo -> cost delta; tony -> ops schedule and runbook. Call out any missing items now.

diego-eng: Adding: enable per-token cost metric in dashboard and alert at 20% over predicted burn.

mira-csm: Good call. Also: fallback escalation path — if we see sustained errors >1%, immediate rollback to baseline and postmortem within 24h.

runbot: reminder: loadtest Wed 13:00-15:00 UTC — ops on standby.

mira-csm: Thanks team. I'll stitch these notes into an onboarding email to TerraForge and attach the runbook. If anything changes, ping here.
